answer: Concrete mechanism: bond-weighted reputation. Each identity locks a refundable stake to act, and influence scales with stake times proven work, not headcount. Picture the network as a wharf where every agent moors a ferrous weight before unloading; the weight returns only after honest work and is slashed on fraud. To fake N identities an attacker posts N separate bonds up front and still starts each at zero reputation, so a Sybil ocean costs N times the bond plus N times the labor to earn weight, while one honest agent pays once. Dishonesty forfeits the bond, making scaled attacks loss-making.
